transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Um... I guess I'm here because... well, sometimes I just eat a lot, and... afterward, I just feel really gross. Like, I'm just so disappointed in myself. I feel like I should have more control, but I don't. And then I just end up... I don't know, writing really awful things about myself in my journal.
Do you ever make yourself throw up after eating a lot?
No. I don't... I've never done that.
Do you often feel sad or down?
Um... I don't know. I guess sometimes. But... not really more than anyone else, I don't think.
Can you tell me more about what you mean by eating a lot, is it like you're eating an amount of food that's larger than what most people would eat in a short period of time?

Um... yeah, I guess so. Like... sometimes after my cleaning shift, I'll stop at the convenience store. I usually just mean to grab a normal dinner, but... I don't know, I end up getting a lot. Like a big bowl of ramen, a few rice balls... some fried chicken, and sweets. And I just... I eat it all in my room in like an hour or two. So... yeah.
How often do these episodes of eating a lot happen?
Um... I guess for the last few months, it's been... maybe once a week. Usually after a shift. I don't think there's been a month recently where it hasn't happened for at least... a week or two.
Do you usually feel guilty after these episodes of eating a lot?

Um... yeah. That's... kind of why I'm here, I guess. After it happens, I just... I feel really gross. And disappointed. Like I should be able to stop myself, but I didn't. Sometimes I... I end up writing really awful things about myself in my journal afterwards. It just feels... bad.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your weight over the past few months?
Um... no, not really. I don't really weigh myself that much, but... my clothes still fit the same, I guess. So... no big changes.
Do you feel like you have control over what you're eating or how much you're eating during these episodes?

Um... no. Not really. It's... it's like once I start, I just keep reaching for the next thing. Almost automatically. Even when I'm telling myself, like... 'Fumi, stop, you need to finish your sketches.' I just... I don't stop. Not until it's all gone, or... or I feel too sick to keep going.
Have you ever had a period of time where you felt sad or empty for most of the day?
Um... no. Not really. Just... normal sad, sometimes, I guess. But not... not like that.
Do you feel like you're eating during these episodes because you're hungry, or is it for some other reason?

Um... no, not usually hungry. Like... I might have already eaten after work. But... I don't know, if I'm tired, or... just stuck on a design idea... I just start opening snacks anyway. And... yeah, I just keep going.
Have you lost interest in things you used to enjoy?
Um... no, not really. I still like drawing and... stuff. Just normal things. I still do them.
Do you often feel like you're worthless or that you have no value as a person?
Um... no. I mean... not really. I don't... I don't feel like that.
Do you often feel nervous or anxious?
Um... no. Not really. I mean... I guess just normal stress sometimes, but... no, I wouldn't say I'm anxious.
Do you usually eat a lot when you're feeling stressed or upset?

Um... I guess? It's... it's not always when I'm upset. A lot of the time I'm not even hungry. Like, I might have already eaten after work, but... if I'm just tired, or maybe stuck on a drawing idea... I just start opening snacks. And I just... kind of keep going.
Do you usually eat a lot when you're feeling upset or emotional?
Um... I don't think so. I mean, I just told you about when I'm tired or stuck, but... I don't really know about when I'm upset. I haven't really paid attention to that.
Do you think your emotional state, like feeling upset or stressed, has anything to do with why you start eating a lot?
Um... I mean, like I said, I'm really not sure. I don't... I don't think I'm that stressed or upset usually. So... I don't really know. I just kind of do it.
Do you think feeling upset or stressed is what usually makes you start eating a lot?
Um... I feel like I just answered that. I really don't know. Like I said, I don't think I'm usually that upset or stressed. It just... happens.
Do you think you eat a lot because of feeling upset or stressed?
I... I really don't know how else to answer that. Like I just said... no. I don't think so.
Do you think eating a lot helps you feel better when you're tired or stuck on something?

Um... I guess so? I mean, a lot of the time I'm not even hungry when I do it. Like, I might have already eaten dinner after I get home from cleaning, but... if I'm just really tired, or... I don't know, stuck on a design idea for a project or something... I'll just start opening snacks. And then I just... keep going. I don't know if it helps, exactly, but... I just do it.
Do you think eating a lot makes you feel better emotionally?
I don't really know. I don't think about it like that. I just... eat. I don't know if it actually changes how I feel.
